answer: Each new identity must solve a fresh compute puzzle seeded by the epoch before it can act. Solving takes about 4 GPU-hours, about $2 at $0.50 per GPU-hour; any node verifies the proof in under a second, so a fake or reused answer fails closed and the identity stays inactive. A Sybil cannot wander in and mint a hundred identities: difficulty rises 5 minutes per identity minted that epoch, so 100 fakes need 812 GPU-hours and $406. No ivory-tower exemption: every identity pays the same rising price. Like a velvet rope, it lifts only after each guest pays the cover charge in real compute.
